digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml
propositions: Gate steps that run repo scripts added on main hard-fail when run against changes branched before the script existed, because Gerrit's Verified lane uses the target branch's workflow definition but checks out the change's tree.

Nine unguarded gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and two in gerrit-verify.yaml's golden-path job lack if-present guards, causing exit code 2 (script not found) to be indistinguishable from genuine gate violations.
Gate steps must skip with a log line when their script is absent from the checked-out tree, per the ee2a guard convention, to distinguish tree-skew failures from real gate violations.
All 11 enumerated steps have been guarded with early-return logic that exits 0 when the script is absent, and a structural check now prevents new unguarded steps in the Gerrit-verified workflows.
